Delhi Implements Anti-Pollution Measures Amidst Air Quality Concerns

Delhi is implementing a series of measures to combat rising air pollution levels, described as a 'double attack' on the city's air. These measures include doubling parking fees, mandating 50% work-from-home for government employees, and imposing restrictions on construction activities. Officials are reportedly considering the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to control pollution. The weather department indicated that while Western Disturbances typically bring rain and wind shifts that alleviate pollution in December and January, the El Niño phenomenon might impact rainfall this year. The restrictions on construction are expected to affect the livelihoods of laborers.
